intro: We always take care of disassembly and reassembly of standard furniture, full blanket, pad and shrink wrapping of all furniture, and all the loading and unloading, at no extra charge. Just a few quick questions about packing:

questions.text: Is your sectional 2 pieces or 3 pieces?
Is the bed in the first bedroom (wood headboard) a full or a queen?
Is the bed with the lit-up headboard in the second bedroom a twin, full or queen?
Are the washer and dryer going with you?
We require TVs to be in TV boxes. Would you like us to supply them for you (a little extra cost), or will you supply your own TV boxes?

options.label: Please supply TV boxes for me
I'll supply my own TV boxes

questions.text: Would you like us to pack up your pictures and artwork, or will you do that yourself?
